voyage.name: Jewish Culture Festival
voyage.content: A classic, one of the biggest Jewish culture festivals in the world. A week of tours, concerts, workshops on cuisine, dance, music and calligraphy topped with a huge final show on Saturday evening. June/July

voyage.name: Bajit Chadasz
voyage.content: Jewish culture festival, organised by Jewish Cultural Centre in Kazimierz with concerts, exhibitions and lectures.

voyage.name: Krakow Film Festival
voyage.content: One of the oldest film events dedicated to documentary, animated and short fiction films in Europe. In a week over 200 films are shown in around six cinemas (10 screens) around the city and in an open air one next to Wawel castle. May

voyage.name: Off Camera
voyage.content: International festival of independent cinema. April

voyage.name: Etiuda and Anima
voyage.content: International film festival built around animations and short films. November

voyage.name: Photomonth
voyage.content: One month long festival with around forty different photography exhibitions around the city. May

voyage.name: Live Music Festival
voyage.content: Typical summer open air music fest. Stars that appeared past years include: Kanye West, Muse, The Chemical Brothers, 50 Cent.

voyage.name: Unsound
voyage.content: World-renowned experimental music and art event. October

voyage.name: Sacrum Profanum
voyage.content: Music fest with concerts of such stars as Steve Reich, Aphex Twin or Kraftwerk taking place in unusual places like churches, museums and factories.

voyage.name: Wianki
voyage.content: St. John's Night (Midsummer) celebration. An evening of concerts finished with a fireworks show taking place on Vistula river banks next to Wawel castle. A booze-up. June

voyage.name: Krakowskie Noce
voyage.content: Five nights (one in each month from May to September): Night of Museums (free museums), Night of Theatres (free theatres), Night of Jazz (free jazz concerts), Cracovia Sacra Night (free concerts of church music) and Night of Poetry (free poetic evenings).

voyage.name: Krakow Valley Golf & Country Club
voyage.content: Also a hotel, shooting range and horse rides.

voyage.name: Royal Kraków Golf & Country Club
voyage.content: Between Wieliczka and Niepołomice. Also a hotel.
